div.head: II Cn 69.1
div.ab: Þæt is þonne ærest, þæt ic bebeode eallum minan gerefan, þæt hi on minan agenan me rihtlice tilian ⁊ me mid þam feormian, ⁊ þæt him nan man ne þearf to feormfultume na þingc syllan, butan he sylf wylle.
Þæt is þonne ærost, þæt ic beode eallum minan gerefan, þæt [hi on] minan agenan tilian ⁊ me mid þam feormian, ⁊ þæt him nan man ne þearf to feormfultume nan þingc syllan, buton he sylf wylle.
Precipio prepositis meis omnibus, ut in meo proprio recte lucrentur et inde mihi seruiant; et nemo cogatur eis ad firmę adiutorium aliquid dare, nisi sponte sua uelit.

Ðæt is ðonne ærost, þæt ic bebeode eallum minan gerefan þæt hig on minon agenan rihtlice tilian ⁊ me mid ðam feormian, ⁊ þæt him nan man ne ðearf to feormfultume nan ðingc syllan, butan he sylf wille.

The first provision is: I command all my reeves to provide for me in accordance with the law from my own property and support me thereby, and [declare] that no man need give them anything as purveyance unless he himself is willing to do so.

First, namely, that I charge all my reeves, that they lawfully provide for me from my own property, and support me from it, and that no one need give anything to them to my provisioning unless he himself wishes.

Nämlich erstens nun, dass ich allen meinen Vögten gebiete, dass sie auf meinem Eigengute (mir G) ordentlich wirthschaften und hieraus mich beköstigen, und dass ihnen niemand irgend etwas als Beköstigungsbeihilfe zu geben braucht, ausser wenn er selbst will.

Namely, first of all, that I command all my reeves that they manage my own estate (for me, G) properly and provision me from it, and that no one need give them anything as a contribution to provisioning, unless he himself wishes.
div.note: A reads ‘beode’; Liebermann supplies ‘hi on’ in A. G's ‘me’ is missing in the other MSS. Liebermann's G reading at ‘þam feormian’: only the italic formatting of K was corrected.
